"""
The ODE system of the model `variable_compartment`: Variable compartments.

Written by sbmlode 0.3.3, SBML L3V2.

Units of the model:

    time       s
    substance  mole
    extent     mole
    volume     l

States x:

       id  name          unit
    1  Vc  growing cell  l
    2  S1  substrate     mole/l
    3  S2  intermediate  mole/l
    4  S3  product       mole/l
    5  B   buffer        mole/l

`initial_values(p)` returns the initial states x0 and the constants p at t = 0,
`f!(dx, x, p, t)` the rates of change of the states and `f_y(x, p, t)` the assigned
values y, the rules and the reaction rates.
`EVENTS` lists the events with the functions of their delays, priorities and
assignments, `event_triggers(x, p, t)` and `event_conditions(x, p, t)` their triggers.
"""
module Variable_compartment

export XIDS, PIDS, YIDS, NAMES, UNITS, P0, EVENTS, initial_values, f!, f_y, event_triggers,
    event_conditions

# the ids of the states x, the constants p and the assigned values y
const XIDS = [
    "Vc",  # growing cell [l]
    "S1",  # substrate [mole/l]
    "S2",  # intermediate [mole/l]
    "S3",  # product [mole/l]
    "B",  # buffer [mole/l]
]
const PIDS = [
    "Ve",  # resized compartment [l]
    "k_g",  # growth rate [1/s]
    "k_a",  # expansion rate [1/s]
    "Va0",  # initial size of Va [l]
    "c_a",  # swelling by the substrate [l^2/mol]
    "k1",  # [1/s]
    "k2",  # [1/s]
]
const YIDS = [
    "dVc_dt",  # rate of growing cell [l/s]
    "Va",  # assigned compartment [l]
    "J1",  # transport [mole/s]
    "dVa_dt",  # rate of assigned compartment [l/s]
    "J2",  # conversion [mole/s]
]

# the names and the units of the ids
const NAMES = Dict{String, Union{Nothing, String}}(
    "Vc" => "growing cell",
    "S1" => "substrate",
    "S2" => "intermediate",
    "S3" => "product",
    "B" => "buffer",
    "Ve" => "resized compartment",
    "k_g" => "growth rate",
    "k_a" => "expansion rate",
    "Va0" => "initial size of Va",
    "c_a" => "swelling by the substrate",
    "k1" => nothing,
    "k2" => nothing,
    "dVc_dt" => "rate of growing cell",
    "Va" => "assigned compartment",
    "J1" => "transport",
    "dVa_dt" => "rate of assigned compartment",
    "J2" => "conversion",
)
const UNITS = Dict{String, Union{Nothing, String}}(
    "Vc" => "l",
    "S1" => "mole/l",
    "S2" => "mole/l",
    "S3" => "mole/l",
    "B" => "mole/l",
    "Ve" => "l",
    "k_g" => "1/s",
    "k_a" => "1/s",
    "Va0" => "l",
    "c_a" => "l^2/mol",
    "k1" => "1/s",
    "k2" => "1/s",
    "dVc_dt" => "l/s",
    "Va" => "l",
    "J1" => "mole/s",
    "dVa_dt" => "l/s",
    "J2" => "mole/s",
)

# the default values of the constants, `NaN` for one without a value, e.g. one which an
# initial assignment sets and `initial_values` computes
const P0 = [
    1.0,  # Ve
    0.1,  # k_g
    0.2,  # k_a
    1.0,  # Va0
    0.1,  # c_a
    1.0,  # k1
    0.5,  # k2
]

"""
    initial_values(p=P0)

The initial states x0 and the constants p at t = 0.

The initial values, initial assignments and the rules they need are evaluated in the
order of their dependencies.

Every constant keeps the value passed.

Returns the initial states x0 and the constants p, a new vector.
"""
function initial_values(p::AbstractVector{<:Real}=P0)
    p = collect(Float64, p)
    t = 0.0  # the initial time
    # constants
    k_a = p[3]  # expansion rate [1/s]
    Va0 = p[4]  # initial size of Va [l]
    c_a = p[5]  # swelling by the substrate [l^2/mol]
    # initial values
    Vc = 1.0  # growing cell [l]
    S1 = 1.0  # substrate [mole/l]
    Va = Va0 * (1.0 + k_a * t) + c_a * S1  # assigned compartment [l]
    S2 = 1.0 / Va  # intermediate [mole/l]
    S3 = 1.0  # product [mole/l]
    B = 1.0  # buffer [mole/l]
    x0 = Float64[Vc, S1, S2, S3, B]
    return x0, p
end

"""
    f!(dx, x, p, t)

The rates of change dx/dt of the states x at the time t, written into dx.
"""
function f!(dx, x, p, t)
    # states
    Vc = x[1]  # growing cell [l]
    S1 = x[2]  # substrate [mole/l]
    S2 = x[3]  # intermediate [mole/l]
    B = x[5]  # buffer [mole/l]
    # constants
    Ve = p[1]  # resized compartment [l]
    k_g = p[2]  # growth rate [1/s]
    k_a = p[3]  # expansion rate [1/s]
    Va0 = p[4]  # initial size of Va [l]
    c_a = p[5]  # swelling by the substrate [l^2/mol]
    k1 = p[6]  # [1/s]
    k2 = p[7]  # [1/s]
    # assigned values and reaction rates
    dVc_dt = k_g * Vc  # rate of growing cell [l/s]
    Va = Va0 * (1.0 + k_a * t) + c_a * S1  # assigned compartment [l]
    J1 = k1 * S1 * Vc  # transport [mole/s]
    dVa_dt = Va0 * k_a + c_a * (-J1 / Vc - S1 / Vc * dVc_dt)  # rate of assigned compartment [l/s]
    J2 = k2 * S2 * Va  # conversion [mole/s]
    # rates of change
    dx[1] = k_g * Vc  # dVc/dt
    dx[2] = -J1 / Vc - S1 / Vc * dVc_dt  # dS1/dt
    dx[3] = (J1 - J2) / Va - S2 / Va * dVa_dt  # dS2/dt
    dx[4] = J2 / Ve  # dS3/dt
    dx[5] = -(B / Vc * dVc_dt)  # dB/dt
    return nothing
end

"""
    f_y(x, p, t)

The assigned values y at the time t, the rules and the reaction rates.
"""
function f_y(x, p, t)
    # states
    Vc = x[1]  # growing cell [l]
    S1 = x[2]  # substrate [mole/l]
    S2 = x[3]  # intermediate [mole/l]
    # constants
    k_g = p[2]  # growth rate [1/s]
    k_a = p[3]  # expansion rate [1/s]
    Va0 = p[4]  # initial size of Va [l]
    c_a = p[5]  # swelling by the substrate [l^2/mol]
    k1 = p[6]  # [1/s]
    k2 = p[7]  # [1/s]
    # assigned values and reaction rates
    dVc_dt = k_g * Vc  # rate of growing cell [l/s]
    Va = Va0 * (1.0 + k_a * t) + c_a * S1  # assigned compartment [l]
    J1 = k1 * S1 * Vc  # transport [mole/s]
    dVa_dt = Va0 * k_a + c_a * (-J1 / Vc - S1 / Vc * dVc_dt)  # rate of assigned compartment [l/s]
    J2 = k2 * S2 * Va  # conversion [mole/s]
    return Float64[dVc_dt, Va, J1, dVa_dt, J2]
end

"""
    event_triggers(x, p, t)

The root function of the trigger of each event, positive where it holds.

An integrator locates the time at which a trigger changes as a root of its function.
At a root, where the function is 0, the trigger itself decides, see
`event_conditions`: `a >= b` holds at `a == b`, `a > b` does not.
"""
function event_triggers(x, p, t)
    return Float64[
        t - 2.0,  # grow
    ]
end

"""
    event_conditions(x, p, t)

Whether the trigger of each event holds.
"""
function event_conditions(x, p, t)
    return Bool[
        t > 2.0,  # grow
    ]
end

"""
    event_values_grow(x, p, t)

The values the event grow assigns, evaluated when its trigger turns true.
"""
function event_values_grow(x, p, t)
    return Float64[
        2.0,  # Ve resized compartment [l]
        NaN,  # S3: not assigned, its amount is kept
    ]
end

"""
    event_sizes_grow(x, p, t)

The sizes of the compartments the event grow changes, after its assignments.
"""
function event_sizes_grow(x, p, t)
    # constants
    Ve = p[1]  # resized compartment [l]
    return Float64[Ve]
end

"""
    event_assign_grow(x, p, t, values)

Execute the event grow: the states x and the constants p with the values, new vectors.

A concentration in a compartment whose size the event changes keeps its amount: it is
scaled with the size before the event and divided by the size after it,
`event_sizes_grow`, evaluated with the values the event assigned.
"""
function event_assign_grow(x, p, t, values)
    # states
    S3 = x[4]  # product [mole/l]
    # constants
    Ve = p[1]  # resized compartment [l]
    x = copy(x)
    p = copy(p)
    p[1] = values[1]  # Ve resized compartment [l]
    sizes = event_sizes_grow(x, p, t)
    x[4] = S3 * Ve / sizes[1]  # S3 product [mole/l]
    return x, p
end

# the events in the order of the model: their flags and the functions of their delay,
# priority and assignments; the trigger of EVENTS[k] is the entry k of `event_triggers`
# and `event_conditions`
const EVENTS = [
    (
        id = "grow",
        initial_value = true,
        persistent = true,
        use_trigger_values = true,
        delay = nothing,
        priority = nothing,
        values = event_values_grow,
        assign = event_assign_grow,
    ),
]

end  # module Variable_compartment
